// HOOKS: PostToolUse records every file the model writes into .studio/wrote.log, so the build knows whether a COMPILE is needed instead of inferring it from the page tree. Inference missed the case where an existing component is edited without changing the tree, and the editor then announced 'Preview is live.' over uncompiled code. The build treats a missing log as 'unknown' and falls back to the old inference, so a hook that fails to fire can never make the build LESS careful.
